This is a dark realm of crags, plinths and rocky mounds sparsely covered with strange vegetation ruins; a mysterious realm hiding the secrets of the [[Realm of Torment]]. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[All Alone in the Darkness]] will lead the party across this area to the next outpost, the [[Gate of Madness (outpost)|Gate of Madness]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Margonite Battle]] **North of the circular [[Margonite]] structure, southwest from northeastern corner. **Northeastern corner, at the exit into the [[Gate of Secrets]]. *[[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Menzies Battle]] **Along the northern edge, in the middle. **Along the southtern edge, towards the southwestern corner. **Near the northwestern corner. *[[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Monolith Hunt]] **Slightly southwest from the center of the map. **South of the circular Margonite structure. *[[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Titan Hunt]] **Southwest, at the exit
